senses.en: using or typical of the natural expressions of a language
senses.zh: 地道的；符合语言习惯的

example.en: Her English is fluent and idiomatic.
example.zh: 她的英语流利且地道。

senses.en: to give a name to; to express in a particular unit

example.en: The loan was denominated in euros.
example.zh: 这笔贷款以欧元计价。

senses.en: annoying and frustrating

example.en: Dealing with the paperwork was a vexatious task.
example.zh: 处理那些文书工作是一件令人恼火的事。

senses.en: (of a legal claim) brought without good reason, mainly to harass

example.en: The court dismissed the claim as vexatious.
example.zh: 法院驳回了这一无理缠讼的诉讼。

senses.en: to exist or happen earlier than something else

example.en: These fossils antedate the earliest known dinosaurs.
example.zh: 这些化石比已知最早的恐龙还要早。

senses.en: to give a document an earlier date than the real one

example.en: He antedated the contract to the first of the month.
example.zh: 他把合同的日期填成了当月一号。

senses.en: a small drop of dew formed on leaves or grass

example.en: Dewdrops sparkled on the grass at dawn.
example.zh: 黎明时露珠在草地上闪闪发光。

senses.en: official documents that prove a fact or qualification

example.en: Applicants must submit copies of their degree certificates.
example.zh: 申请者必须提交学位证书的复印件。

senses.en: a title used before a woman's name, without indicating marriage status
senses.zh: 女士（不表明婚姻状况的称谓）

example.en: Please welcome Ms Carter to the stage.
example.zh: 请欢迎卡特女士上台。

senses.en: abbreviation of multiple sclerosis, a chronic disease of the nervous system

example.en: Researchers are studying new treatments for MS.
example.zh: 研究人员正在研究多发性硬化症的新疗法。

senses.en: giving pleasure or fun

example.en: We had an enjoyable evening at the concert.
example.zh: 我们在音乐会上度过了一个愉快的夜晚。

senses.en: someone or something that jumps

example.en: She is one of the best high jumpers in the country.
example.zh: 她是全国最优秀的跳高运动员之一。

senses.en: (British English) a knitted sweater; (US) a sleeveless dress worn over a blouse
senses.zh: （英式）针织套头毛衣；（美式）罩衫式连衣裙

example.en: It's cold outside, so put on a warm jumper.
example.zh: 外面很冷，穿件暖和的毛衣吧。

senses.en: a group of people traveling together, often with camels or wagons

example.en: A caravan of camels crossed the desert.
example.zh: 一支骆驼商队穿越了沙漠。

senses.en: a wheeled vehicle people can live in while traveling (British usage)

example.en: They spent the summer holiday in a caravan by the sea.
example.zh: 他们在海边的一辆旅行拖车里度过了暑假。

senses.en: to travel or holiday in a caravan

example.en: They enjoy caravanning around the country.
example.zh: 他们喜欢开着拖车环游全国。

senses.en: the time in a woman's life when menstruation permanently stops

example.en: Many women experience hot flashes during menopause.
example.zh: 许多女性在绝经期会出现潮热。

senses.en: a small printed notice handed out or posted to advertise something

example.en: They handed out flyers for the concert downtown.
example.zh: 他们在市中心发放音乐会传单。

senses.en: a person who flies, especially often or skillfully

example.en: The pilot was known as a fearless flyer.
example.zh: 这名飞行员以大胆无畏著称。

senses.en: to meet someone or find something unexpectedly

example.en: We encountered an old friend at the station.
example.zh: 我们在车站偶然遇到了一位老朋友。

senses.en: to experience or have to deal with something, especially a problem

example.en: The team encountered several problems during the project.
example.zh: 团队在项目期间遇到了几个问题。

senses.en: a meeting with someone or something, especially one that is unexpected

example.en: Their first encounter was at a book fair.
example.zh: 他们第一次相遇是在一个书展上。

senses.en: relating to thinking, understanding, memory, and other mental processes
senses.zh: 认知的；与思考、理解和记忆等心理过程有关的

example.en: Sleep supports cognitive function, including memory and attention.
example.zh: 睡眠有助于认知功能，包括记忆和注意力。

senses.en: happening or existing without stopping or breaking

example.en: The continuous noise from the construction site kept us awake all night.
example.zh: 建筑工地连续不断的噪音让我们整夜未眠。

senses.en: of a mathematical function: having no sudden changes in value

example.en: A continuous function has no breaks or jumps in its graph.
example.zh: 连续函数的图像没有断裂或跳跃。

senses.en: a territory controlled by another country and often settled by people from it

example.en: The region was governed as a colony for many years.
example.zh: 该地区多年来一直作为殖民地被管辖。

senses.en: a group of animals, plants, or microorganisms living or growing together
senses.zh: （动物、植物或微生物的）群体；菌落

example.en: A single ant colony can contain thousands of workers.
example.zh: 一个蚁群可以包含数千只工蚁。

senses.en: a dramatic work in which the story is told mainly through singing, usually with an orchestra

example.en: We went to see the opera Carmen.
example.zh: 我们去看了歌剧《卡门》。

senses.en: the event of a baby or animal being born

example.en: The birth of their first child brought the family great joy.
example.zh: 他们第一个孩子的出生给全家带来了极大的喜悦。

senses.en: the beginning or origin of something

example.en: The invention of writing marked the birth of recorded history.
example.zh: 文字的发明标志着有记录历史的开端。

senses.en: a formal decision or statement agreed by a meeting or vote

example.en: The committee passed a resolution to improve working conditions.
example.zh: 委员会通过了一项改善工作条件的决议。

senses.en: a firm decision to do or not do something

example.en: She made a resolution to exercise every morning.
example.zh: 她下定决心每天早晨锻炼。

senses.en: the act of solving a problem or ending a disagreement

example.en: The two sides are seeking a peaceful resolution to the dispute.
example.zh: 双方正在寻求和平解决这一争端。

senses.en: the ability of a screen, lens, or image to show small details clearly

example.en: This camera records video at high resolution.
example.zh: 这台相机以高分辨率录制视频。

senses.en: A statement or description that makes something clear or easier to understand.

example.en: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the diagram.
example.zh: 老师对这张图作了清楚的解释。

senses.en: A reason or justification given for an action or event.

example.en: He offered no explanation for being late.
example.zh: 他没有为迟到作出任何解释。

senses.en: a strong feeling or desire to do something

example.en: She felt a sudden urge to laugh.
example.zh: 她突然感到想笑的冲动。

senses.en: to strongly encourage someone to do something

example.en: He urged her to apply for the job.
example.zh: 他敦促她申请这份工作。

senses.en: to strongly recommend or ask for something

example.en: The report urges immediate action.
example.zh: 报告敦促立即采取行动。

senses.en: shining brightly with light

example.en: The radiant morning sun lit up the whole valley.
example.zh: 早晨灿烂的阳光照亮了整个山谷。

senses.en: showing great happiness and health; glowing
senses.zh: 容光焕发的；喜气洋洋的

example.en: She looked radiant on her wedding day.
example.zh: 她在婚礼那天容光焕发。

senses.en: the point in the sky from which the meteors in a meteor shower appear to come

example.en: Most meteors in this shower appear to come from a single radiant.
example.zh: 这场流星雨中的大多数流星似乎都来自同一个辐射点。

senses.en: a bright vivid red color, sometimes with an orange tinge

example.en: She wore a scarf in bright scarlet.
example.zh: 她戴了一条鲜红色的围巾。

senses.en: bright red in color

example.en: The maple leaves turned scarlet in autumn.
example.zh: 枫叶在秋天变成了鲜红色。

senses.en: a bluish-white metal used to coat other metals and in alloys

example.en: Zinc is essential for a healthy immune system.
example.zh: 锌对健康的免疫系统至关重要。

senses.en: to coat or cover something with zinc

example.en: The steel pipes were zinced to prevent rust.
example.zh: 这些钢管经过镀锌以防生锈。

senses.en: not wasting money or resources; inexpensive to use

example.en: This small car is very economical to run.
example.zh: 这辆小车的使用成本很低。

senses.en: using effort, time or materials efficiently with no waste

example.en: She made economical use of her time and finished early.
example.zh: 她高效利用时间，提前完成了。

senses.en: a person whose job is carrying luggage at a station, airport or hotel

example.en: A porter helped us carry our bags to the taxi.
example.zh: 一位行李员帮我们把行李搬到出租车上。

senses.en: a person employed to guard or take care of the entrance of a building

example.en: The porter opened the gate for visitors.
example.zh: 门房为访客打开了大门。

senses.en: a dark beer brewed with roasted malt

example.en: He ordered a pint of porter at the pub.
example.zh: 他在酒馆点了一品脱黑啤酒。

senses.en: to make someone feel sad and without hope

example.en: The rainy weather can depress people's mood.
example.zh: 下雨的天气会让人心情低落。

senses.en: to make prices, markets or activity fall to a lower level

example.en: Weak demand has depressed the prices of many goods.
example.zh: 需求疲软压低了许多商品的价格。

senses.en: a trained professional who treats physical or mental health problems

example.en: My physical therapist helps me stretch after my injury.
example.zh: 我的理疗师帮我做伤后拉伸训练。

senses.en: the state of being ready or glad to do something

example.en: She showed great willingness to help with the project.
example.zh: 她非常乐意帮助做这个项目。

senses.en: extremely; very

example.en: The view from the mountain was incredibly beautiful.
example.zh: 山上的景色美极了。

senses.en: in a way that is hard to believe
senses.zh: 难以置信地；不可思议地

example.en: She performed incredibly well under pressure.
example.zh: 她在压力下表现得难以置信地好。

senses.en: at the middle point of a distance or process

example.en: We stopped halfway to rest.
example.zh: 我们在中途停下来休息。

senses.en: located at, or done only partly to, the middle point

example.en: They reached a halfway solution to the dispute.
example.zh: 他们对争议达成了一个折中的解决方案。

senses.en: the complete independent authority of a state to govern itself

example.en: Each nation has the right to protect its sovereignty.
example.zh: 每个国家都有权维护自己的主权。

senses.en: supreme power or authority, especially that of a ruler

example.en: The king claimed sovereignty over the entire region.
example.zh: 国王宣称对整个地区拥有统治权。

senses.en: the process of selling a state-owned company or service to private owners

example.en: The privatisation of the railway attracted a lot of criticism.
example.zh: 铁路私有化招致了很多批评。

senses.en: a Scandinavian seafarer who raided and settled in Europe from the 8th to 11th centuries

example.en: The Vikings sailed to North America around the year 1000.
example.zh: 维京人大约在公元1000年前后航行到北美洲。

senses.en: successful, respected and admired

example.en: She is a distinguished scientist in her field.
example.zh: 她是她所在领域里杰出的科学家。

senses.en: impressive in appearance or manner

example.en: He looked distinguished in his grey suit.
example.zh: 他穿着灰色西装显得气度不凡。

senses.en: a book about the author's own life and experiences

example.en: She published a memoir about her years abroad.
example.zh: 她出版了一本关于她海外岁月的回忆录。

senses.en: a scholarly essay or record on a particular subject

example.en: The society published a memoir on local history.
example.zh: 该学会发表了一篇关于当地历史的专题论文。

senses.en: a payment made by a company to its shareholders from its profits

example.en: The company pays a dividend to shareholders twice a year.
example.zh: 这家公司每年向股东支付两次股息。

senses.en: a number to be divided by another number

example.en: In 12 divided by 3, the dividend is 12.
example.zh: 在12除以3中，被除数是12。

senses.en: a sloping surface connecting two levels

example.en: The wheelchair ramp makes the building accessible.
example.zh: 轮椅坡道让这栋楼便于通行。

senses.en: to increase or become more intense suddenly

example.en: The company ramped up production before the holidays.
example.zh: 公司在假期前提高了产量。

senses.en: a person who shows people to their seats at events

example.en: An usher showed us to our seats in the theater.
example.zh: 一位引座员把我们带到剧院的座位。

senses.en: to show someone where to go or lead them somewhere

example.en: The staff ushered the guests into the hall.
example.zh: 工作人员把客人引进大厅。

senses.en: to mark or help bring about the start of something new

example.en: The invention ushered in a new era of communication.
example.zh: 这项发明开创了通信的新时代。

senses.en: a senior university administrator, often in charge of academic affairs

example.en: The university appointed a new provost to oversee academic programs.
example.zh: 这所大学任命了一位新教务长来管理学术项目。

senses.en: a senior military police officer or official in charge of discipline
senses.zh: 宪兵队长；（某些地区的）治安官

example.en: The provost marshals ensured order on the military base.
example.zh: 宪兵军官们维持了军事基地的秩序。

senses.en: the bending or turning aside of something from its straight path or direction

example.en: The deflection of the ball surprised the goalkeeper.
example.zh: 球的偏转让守门员吃了一惊。

senses.en: a change in the direction of a moving object caused by hitting or being hit

example.en: A deflection off the defender took the shot into the net.
example.zh: 皮球经防守队员一挡变向飞入球网。

senses.en: the outer edge or border of a city or town, usually used in the plural form 'outskirts'
senses.zh: 郊区；市郊（通常用复数 outskirts）

example.en: They live on the outskirts of the city.
example.zh: 他们住在城市郊区。

senses.en: a person who teaches or works in education

example.en: She has worked as an educator for over twenty years.
example.zh: 她从事教育工作已有二十多年。

senses.en: including many details; thorough and complete

example.en: She gave a detailed description of the house.
example.zh: 她对那栋房子作了详细的描述。

senses.en: clearly true and impossible to question or argue against
senses.zh: 无可争议的；不容置疑的

example.en: The fingerprints provided indisputable proof of his presence.
example.zh: 指纹提供了他到过现场的无可争议的证据。

senses.en: an extra performance given at the audience's request
senses.zh: 返场演出；（观众要求的）加演

example.en: The band returned for an encore.
example.zh: 乐队返场加演了一次。

senses.en: to call for a repeat performance from a performer
senses.zh: 要求（加演）；（观众）喝彩要求再演

example.en: The audience encored the singer after her final song.
example.zh: 歌手唱完最后一首歌后，观众要求她加演。

senses.en: objects made of glass, especially drinking glasses and tableware

example.en: She packed the glassware carefully before the move.
example.zh: 搬家前她小心地把玻璃器皿包好。

senses.en: a little at a time; gradually in separate pieces

example.en: The reforms were introduced piecemeal over a decade.
example.zh: 改革在十年间零碎地逐步推行。

senses.en: done or made one piece at a time; not complete or systematic

example.en: Their piecemeal approach failed to solve the whole problem.
example.zh: 他们零敲碎打的方法未能解决整个问题。

senses.en: soft, loose, and hanging limply; not stiff

example.en: The puppy's long ears were floppy.
example.zh: 小狗的长耳朵软塌塌的。

senses.en: an old magnetic disk used to store computer data

example.en: He saved the document to a floppy.
example.zh: 他把文件存到了一张软盘上。

senses.en: the upper side of something; the positive aspect of a situation

example.en: The upside of moving is being closer to family.
example.zh: 搬家好的一面是离家人更近。

senses.en: to scatter things at intervals among other things

example.en: Tall trees were interspersed among the houses.
example.zh: 高大的树木散布在房屋之间。

senses.en: to lower the rank, value, or rating of something or someone

example.en: The agency downgraded the company's credit rating.
example.zh: 该机构下调了这家公司的信用评级。

senses.en: to make something seem less important

example.en: Officials tried to downgrade the seriousness of the incident.
example.zh: 官员们试图淡化该事件的严重性。

senses.en: a member of a Bantu people of eastern South Africa

example.en: Many Zulus live in KwaZulu-Natal province.
example.zh: 许多祖鲁人生活在夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省。

senses.en: the Bantu language spoken by the Zulu people

example.en: She is learning to speak Zulu.
example.zh: 她在学习说祖鲁语。

senses.en: loose granular material made of tiny rock or mineral particles
senses.zh: 由细小岩石或矿物颗粒组成的松散物质；沙子

example.en: The children built a castle in the sand.
example.zh: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。

senses.en: to smooth or clean a surface by rubbing it with sandpaper or sand
senses.zh: 用砂纸或沙子打磨或清洁表面

example.en: She sanded the old chair before painting it.
example.zh: 她给旧椅子打磨后才上漆。

senses.en: a firm belief that someone or something is reliable, honest, or true

example.en: She has complete trust in her team.
example.zh: 她完全信任她的团队。

senses.en: to believe that someone is honest or reliable, or that something is true

example.en: I trust you to keep this secret.
example.zh: 我相信你会保守这个秘密。

senses.en: a legal arrangement in which money or property is held for someone's benefit

example.en: The family set up a trust for the children.
example.zh: 家人为孩子们设立了一个信托。

senses.en: to give someone responsibility for something valuable

example.en: He was trusted with the company's finances.
example.zh: 他被委以管理公司财务的重任。

senses.en: a raised area of land, lower than a mountain

example.en: We walked to the top of the hill to watch the sunset.
example.zh: 我们走到小山顶上看日落。

senses.en: a small heap or mound of something

example.en: The children made a hill of sand near the water.
example.zh: 孩子们在水边堆了一个沙堆。

senses.en: to bank soil up around a plant

example.en: Farmers hill potatoes to protect the growing stems.
example.zh: 农民给马铃薯培土以保护正在生长的茎。

senses.en: the process of making something warmer

example.en: Heating the water takes about ten minutes.
example.zh: 把水加热大约需要十分钟。

senses.en: equipment that warms a building

example.en: The heating is not working, so the room is cold.
example.zh: 暖气坏了，所以房间很冷。

senses.en: violent and cruel; intended to hurt someone

example.en: The dog gave a vicious bite.
example.zh: 那条狗狠狠地咬了一口。

senses.en: very severe or harmful

example.en: They were caught in a vicious storm.
example.zh: 他们遇上了猛烈的暴风雨。

senses.en: relating to or near the North or South Pole

example.en: Polar bears live in the Arctic region.
example.zh: 北极熊生活在北极地区。

senses.en: completely opposite in character or opinion

example.en: Their political views are polar opposites.
example.zh: 他们的政治观点截然相反。

senses.en: having opposite electrical charges, as in chemistry

example.en: Water is a polar molecule.
example.zh: 水是极性分子。

senses.en: extreme tiredness; the state of having no energy left

example.en: After the long hike, she felt complete exhaustion.
example.zh: 长途徒步之后，她感到筋疲力尽。

senses.en: the act of using something up completely

example.en: The exhaustion of natural resources is a global concern.
example.zh: 自然资源的耗尽是全球关注的问题。

senses.en: to surround something completely, especially with a fence, wall, etc.

example.en: They enclosed the garden with a low fence.
example.zh: 他们用矮栅栏把花园围了起来。

senses.en: to put something inside an envelope or package, or to include it with a letter

example.en: I enclose a copy of the report with this letter.
example.zh: 随信附上一份报告的复印件。

senses.en: a wild dog-like animal that hunts in packs

example.en: A pack of wolves howled in the distance.
example.zh: 一群狼在远处嚎叫。

senses.en: to eat food very quickly

example.en: He wolfed down his lunch before the meeting.
example.zh: 他在会议前狼吞虎咽地吃完了午饭。

senses.en: the chance that something will happen; probability

example.en: There is a strong likelihood of rain this afternoon.
example.zh: 今天下午下雨的可能性很大。

senses.en: to pay someone money for loss, injury, or work done

example.en: The company compensated the workers for the extra hours they worked.
example.zh: 公司为工人加班的时间支付了报酬。

senses.en: to make up for something bad or missing

example.en: Her enthusiasm compensates for her lack of experience.
example.zh: 她的热情弥补了经验上的不足。

senses.en: a type of popular music with rhythmic spoken lyrics

example.en: He grew up listening to rap and hip-hop.
example.zh: 他是听着说唱乐和嘻哈乐长大的。

senses.en: to speak the words of a rap song rhythmically

example.en: She can rap faster than anyone in her crew.
example.zh: 她的说唱比队里任何人都快。

senses.en: a quick light knock or sharp blow

example.en: There was a rap at the door.
example.zh: 有人敲了敲门。

senses.en: to hit something with quick light knocks

example.en: He rapped on the window to get her attention.
example.zh: 他敲了敲窗户以引起她的注意。

senses.en: attractive and making you want to do or have something

example.en: The dessert menu looked very tempting.
example.zh: 甜品菜单看起来非常诱人。

senses.en: involving three or more countries or parties

example.en: The countries signed a multilateral trade agreement.
example.zh: 这些国家签署了一项多边贸易协定。

senses.en: to pull down or destroy a building completely

example.en: The old factory will be demolished next month.
example.zh: 这座旧工厂将于下个月被拆除。

senses.en: to destroy or defeat something completely

example.en: The team demolished their opponents 5–0.
example.zh: 这支球队以5比0横扫对手。

senses.en: a performance or interpretation of a piece of music, a role, or a text

example.en: Her rendering of the song moved the audience.
example.zh: 她对这首歌的演绎打动了观众。

senses.en: a translation or the way something is expressed in another form

example.en: This rendering of the poem captures its sadness.
example.zh: 这首诗的这个译本传达出了它的哀伤。

senses.en: a drawing or digital image showing how something will look

example.en: The architect showed us a rendering of the new building.
example.zh: 建筑师给我们看了新建筑的效果图。

senses.en: the quality of being impressively beautiful, grand, or splendid

example.en: Visitors marveled at the magnificence of the palace.
example.zh: 游客们惊叹于宫殿的富丽堂皇。

senses.en: a detachable lock with a hinged shackle that can be snapped shut

example.en: He put a padlock on the garden gate.
example.zh: 他在花园门上装了一把挂锁。

senses.en: to fasten something with a padlock

example.en: She padlocked the bicycle to the railing.
example.zh: 她用挂锁把自行车锁在栏杆上。

senses.en: to officially declare something invalid or cancel it

example.en: The court annulled the marriage because it was never legal.
example.zh: 法院宣告这桩婚姻无效，因为它从来就不合法。

senses.en: a section at the end of a book or play that concludes the story

example.en: The novel ends with an epilogue set ten years later.
example.zh: 小说以设定在十年后的尾声结尾。

senses.en: to waste time or money little by little on unimportant things

example.en: He frittered away his savings on useless gadgets.
example.zh: 他把积蓄浪费在无用的小玩意儿上。

senses.en: a small piece of food coated in batter and fried

example.en: Corn fritters are a popular street snack.
example.zh: 玉米煎饼是很受欢迎的街头小吃。

senses.en: honest and free from deceit

example.en: He answered with a guileless smile.
example.zh: 他带着坦率的微笑回答。

senses.en: done quickly and efficiently

example.en: They promised an expeditious review of the application.
example.zh: 他们承诺会对申请进行高效的审核。

senses.en: a sudden feeling of alarm or dismay

example.en: The sudden cancellation caused consternation among the fans.
example.zh: 突然的取消让歌迷们大为惊愕。
